summary: An autumn 2023 community feature on family-friendly picnic spots and outdoor games in the city. It profiles three parks (Mayfair Park, Riverfront Greens, Lakeview Terrace) and a range of games from frisbee, soccer and tag to chalk art, sack races, capture the flag, board games and treasure hunts, illustrated with quotes from local families seen between September and October.
one_line: A feature on city picnic parks and popular family outdoor games observed by local families in September and October 2023.
key_facts: Since September 1st, 2023, parks and recreation areas across the city have seen more picnic-goers.
Mayfair Park is a tranquil suburban park with old oaks offering shade; Sandra Hernandez said her family comes every weekend for its peacefulness.
Riverfront Greens is a bustling entertainment hub that often hosts local food truck festivals and live music; David Chang said on September 12th it is 'a picnic with a side of culture.'
Lakeview Terrace overlooks Crystal Lake and was voted the top picnic spot in a recent local survey.
Amelia and Oliver Harper held a stone-skipping contest at Lakeview Terrace on September 19th; Oliver reported 'Eight skips!'
Jack Thomson, a father of three, said frisbee appeals because 'All you need is a frisbee and some open space'; the Thomson family was seen playing on September 22nd.
Maria Gonzalez led a mini soccer tournament on September 26th, saying kids learn teamwork and are ready for a nap afterward.
Eli Anderson of the Anderson family shouted 'You're it!' during a game of tag on September 29th.
Sara Kim and her two daughters created a chalk mural on September 30th.
The Patel family organized a sack race on the first weekend of October using pillowcases or burlap sacks.
The Johnson family played Capture the Flag on October 8th, showing it engages body and mind.
Lisa Schwartz said on October 15th that board games like Scrabble let families unplug and get fresh air; Catan and Monopoly are also mentioned.
The O'Connor family held a treasure hunt with pre-planned clues on October 22nd.
